fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: I’ve finally reached level 10! Come to think of it, I remember hearing something about choosing a job once I hit level 10…
fields.after: It seems Phil, the informant of Lith Harbor, has something to say to all novice adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: Let’s head to the Information Broker Phil in Lith Harbor to learn more about job advancement.
fields.after: Phil, the informant of Lith Harbor, explained that once you reach Level 10, you can make a job advancement in each town of Victoria Island. They asked me to help out the townsfolk in Lith Harbor and hunt monsters to reach Level 10, then return.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: I learned from Phil that I can choose to become a Swordman, Magician, Archer, or Rogue. It seems like I can’t change it once I choose, so I need to think carefully…
fields.after: After reaching Level 10, I was able to get information about the job advancement from Phil. It seems you can advance to a Warrior in Perion, a Magician in Ellinia, an Archer in Henesys, and a Thief in Perion. Talking to Phil will allow you to go straight to your town of choice. Since a job advancement cannot be undone once made, I'd better choose carefully...

She says that she'll return the cape when she gets her things back... The items are 1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow explained that she once lived much deeper inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but while out on a walk she was attacked by Glowshrooms and dropped the map she had drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the Glowshrooms east of Forgotten Hollow and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.
fields.after: Zelya, a cave fairy in the Forgotten Hollow, told me about how her people once lived deep, deep inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but she was attacked by Glowshrooms while out on a walk and dropped the map she'd drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the Glowshrooms, east of Forgotten Hollow, and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.

fields.after: Apparently, there's someone in Kerning City by the name of Icarus that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky, 24/7.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)

He seems like a nice guy who has an unquenchable thirst for flying, and he wants to create a hang glider to fulfill his dream of flying. He asks me if I can gather up the materials for the hang glider, and even though the process of making the hang glider seems dubious at best, I can't say no to his sincere desire to fly. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.
fields.after: I went to meet Icarus on top of a building in Kerning City. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: I got the materials needed for Icarus to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider. I don't know if this will really work, but he might end up succeeding, so I should check up on him around the time the hang glider should be ready to take flight.
fields.after: I got the materials Icarus needed to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider fly... I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named Trainer Bartos of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...
fields.after: I met a fairy in Ellinia that was busily studying the magic of life. Her name was Mar, and she took a look at the lifeless doll that was once my pet for me. A pet trainer named Trainer Bartos in Henesys might know something about the scroll of life, so I should start there...

changed.name: A Clue to the Secret Book

fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: I heard Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood is going through hard times... I should go check on him.
fields.after: I hear Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood is going through hard times... I should go check on him.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: At the VIP sauna in Sleepywood, I met this bald man called Mr. Wetbottom. He has a son, and apparently he ran away from home one day with a book that he cares deeply for. He requested that I find his son and get the book back from him. For a reward, he's offering me a nice sauna robe. He also told me his son Ronnie hangs out at a tree tunnel around Ellinia, so maybe I can find him there. Anyway, is that book more important to him than his son What kind of a book is it anyway...
fields.after: I met an old, balding man named Mr. Wetbottom in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. Mr. Wetbottom told me that his son, Ronnie, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around Ellinia. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in this book of his...

However, it seems that the fairies may not have as much animosity toward humans now... at least that's a good thing.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I ran into Rowen the Fairy again, who gave me Fresh Milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. Back then, she seemed to be keeping her guard up against humans, but now, it looks like she accepts me as Ronnie's friend... Rowen the Fairy is assistant to the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and she tells me that he is concerned about the Cursed Dolls that he made with his black magic a long, long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupins took them and ran away. The Lupins have since become zombies and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupins and take the Cursed Dolls away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect 50 cursed dolls, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...

If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...

Taking on Jr. Necki might be a bit tricky, but it shouldn’t be too much trouble for me!

fields.after: It seems that Casey in Henesys Park knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.

I should try to gather them when I have the time.
fields.after: I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting if I brought him enough Monster Cards. I should try to gather them when I have time.

fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: Sophia looked genuinely surprised when I handed her all the materials needed for the Sparkling Rock. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she hands over a Sparkling Rock made of the materials I gathered. Hmm, the Sparkling Rock...gives off a strange light and then... starts glittering, and... whoa, I understand why people want this! It's mesmerizing! Well, now I just have to trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.
fields.after: Sophia looked genuinely surprised when I handed her all the materials she needed to make the Sparkling Rock. Well, it wasn't easy! I can understand why someone would want one of these! It's mesmerizing! Well, now I just have to trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.

To make the sparkling rock, she says she needs 30 Squishy Liquids, 30 Leafs, 30 Octopus Legs and 1 Arcon's Blood. Everything looks reasonable enough... wait, Arcon's Blood ! Fortunately, Sophia knows where to get some. She says to have a chat with Manji, who's somewhere around Perion.

fields.before: I got a request from Maya of Henesys, who has been collecting various items. She wanted 20 each of Orange Mushroom Cap, Green Mushroom Cap, Blue Mushroom Cap, and Horny Mushroom Cap. Maybe... well it looks like I can get these from the monsters around the prairie...
fields.after: I got a request from Maya of Henesys, who likes collecting all kinds of items. She wants 20 of each of the following: Orange Mushroom Cap, Green Mushroom Cap, Blue Mushroom Cap, and Horny Mushroom Cap. It looks like I can get all of these from hunting monsters around the prairie...

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)

fields.after: Maya asked me to gather 1 Diamond, 50 Stone Golem Rubble, and 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble. I can get them by defeating monsters at the Golem's Temple, which is on the way from Henesys to the dungeon... but this is getting way too hard!

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: I got all the items Maya requested for the last time... or is it As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a cape her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks like it's brand new!

Collect 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps as proof. You contemplate telling Pia she's asking to be teased, walking around the forest in a bear costume, but you decide against it.

fields.after: I got Ronnie all kinds of yummy snacks and finally got his dad's Secret Book in exchange. I really want to take just one peek...

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I went to see Rina of Henesys first to help feed the hungry Ronnie.
fields.after: I went to see Rina of Henesys to help feed the hungry Ronnie.

fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: The Stranger I met in Niora Hospital is, surprisingly, a ghost! She remained in the hospital, unaware that she had died, waiting for Naora to return... Now unwilling to accept her death, she told me that in order to live again, she needs me to defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 Charm of the Undeads. She asked for my help one last time. I wonder if that’s really all it takes to bring her back...
fields.after: The stranger I met in the Niora Hospital was, surprisingly, a ghost! She's been in the hospital all this time--unaware that she'd died, waiting for Dr. Niora to return... Now, unwilling to accept her death, she needs me to defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 Charm of the Undead to bring her back to life. I really wonder if that's all it takes...

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: Jane Doe who I met in Niora Hospital was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't live again with Charm of the Undead. It seems that she already knew she couldn't make it... I really hope she finds peace.
fields.after: Jane Doe, whom I met in the Niora Hospital was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't be revived with the Charm of the Undead. It seemed, deep down, that she already knew that, though... I really hope she finds peace.

fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: I heard something happened to the tribespeople of Perion. I should go ask Ayan about this.
fields.after: I hear something happened to the tribespeople of Perion. I should go ask Ayan about this.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I met up with Ayan in Perion. She told me that a few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of alligators. She was worried about the sudden surge of alligators taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.
fields.after: I spoke with Ayan in Perion. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of Ligators. She's worried about the sudden surge of Ligators, and other alligator monsters, taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I found Ayan, and she seemed to be panicking. She was walking around the swamp when she ran into a bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators than the previous one. She ran back to Perion and has been looking for me to ask me for help ever since. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins along the way.
fields.after: I went to see Ayan, and she was in a panic. She had been walking around the swamp one day, when she ran into an even bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators, Crocos. She immediately turned and ran back to Perion. She'd been waiting for me to come by since then, hoping I could help her. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: At Ayan's request, I took out 120 Crocos in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators before they spawn out of control.
fields.after: At Ayan's request, I took out 120 Crocos in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators so they don't spawn out of control.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)

fields.after: Does Dances with Balrog of Perion have even greater lessons to teach me

fields.after: Dances with Balrog of Perion seemed surprised to see how much stronger I had become compared to before.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)

I should check it out later...
fields.after: I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh... As a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... Not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at Construction Site B1... I should check it out later...

changed.name: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash

fields.before: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She seemed really worried about how she lost her rent money because a Stirge flew over and snatched a bundle of money away from her. Man... do I have to walk back in there again... can I just pay the rent for her Anyway like last time, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2 and find the bundle of money she lost. Aye, better go in there now...
fields.after: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a Stirge flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again... Can I just pay her rent for her at this point Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...

changed.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: In front of the Sleepywood Hotel, I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on... and he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called Pink Anthurium. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower... I should remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia... I should go there and talk to this guy Shane...
fields.after: I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader, in front of the Sleepywood Hotel. He appears to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He recently discovered a place that grows the last herb he needs for a medicine he's been working on... He asked me to go deep in the forest and grab the Pink Anthurium. It's made of green grass and a small pink flower... I need to make sure I get him the same exact one. Shane from Ellinia can take me to the right place.

fields.label: Description (Stage 3)
fields.before: Thankfully I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a scroll for overall armor. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. From what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I better get back in the Forest of Patience when I have some time...
fields.after: Thankfully, I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and, as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a scroll for overall armor. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. From what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I should go back to the Forest of Patience when I have some spare time...

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex who ran away from home because of a disagreement with his father, Chief Stan in Henesys. But Alex has become exhausted from being on the run with no money. Now he wants to return home and try to work things out with his strict, but loving, father. But he wants me to persuade his father not to punish him when he returns home. He also says he wants me to bring the Old Gold Watch his mother left him when she died as proof that I successfully persuaded his father.
fields.after: On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex, who's run away from home because of a fight with his father, Chief Stan, in Henesys. But Alex is exhausted from being on the run and is out of money. He wants to go home and try to work things out with his strict, but admittedly loving, father. He asked me if I could persuade his father to not punish him for what he did. Also, he wants me to bring the Old Gold Watch his mother left him when she died, as proof that he really did have his father's forgiveness.

fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: I got a third request from Nella. Andre, an assistant at the Hair Salon, is apparently struggling with meals as a lifelong bachelor and wants to make some tasty Seafood Soup. I'll need to defeat 30 Octopuses and collect 20 Octopus Legs. I'll also need 1 Pure Water. Once I've gathered everything, I should bring it to Nella.
fields.after: I got a third request from Nella. Andre, an assistant at the Kerning City Hair Salon, is a lifelong bachelor and is apparently struggling with improving his cooking skills. He wants to try his hand at making some tasty seafood soup. I'll need to defeat 30 Octopus and collect 20 Octopus Legs, and also get 1 Pure Water. Once I've gathered everything, I need to deliver them to Nella.

fields.label: Description (Stage 1)
fields.before: At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He was even more blunt and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's Old Gold Watch as proof. Now, all I need to do is get this watch to Alex in Kerning City.
fields.after: At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He was even more ornery and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back home with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's Old Gold Watch as proof. Now, all I need to do is deliver this watch to Alex in Kerning City.

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I came across Manji again, whom I had first met in Perion when making the medicine for Maya, the little girl in Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I had become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who died in his place. Ever since then, Manji had held onto Tristan’s sword. But the blade, corrupted by Balrog’s evil aura, has become so worn down that it can hardly even be called a sword anymore… Manji handed me the Old Gladius he had been keeping and asked me to awaken it back to its true form. Once fully awakened, it is said to become the Hero's Gladius. Just as Manji said, I should seek out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.
fields.after: I visited Manji again, whom I'd first met in Perion, when making the medicine for Maya of Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I've become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who ended up dying in Manji's place. Ever since then, Manji has held onto Tristan's sword. However, the blade was so corrupted by Balrog that it's almost too worn down to even be called a sword anymore... Manji handed me the Old Gladius that he'd held onto all these years and asked me to reawaken its true form. Once fully awakened, it will become the Hero's Gladius. Manji told me to begin with seeking out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.

fields.after: The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, is giving me a test to see if I'm fit to become his apprentice. He said that a true blacksmith must have the required amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to defeat the monsters around Perion and bring back the raw ore they drop.

changed.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies

fields.label: Description (Stage 2)
fields.before: I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying monsters and animals in Henesys. His bright smile and the easygoing demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding clues of his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this...
fields.after: I met Bruce, who's been studying the monsters and animals around Henesys. His bright smile and easygoing demeanor belie the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time now. The reason he's been studying the mushroom monsters is to uncover clues as to his daughter's whereabouts. He asked if I could help him out, and I just couldn't say no to such a worthy cause...

fields.after: Zelya managed to restore her precious map and tried to follow it back to her old home, but she couldn't make it past the fierce monsters blocking the way. She asked me to defeat the monsters west of the Forgotten Hollow to help her get home safely.

fields.after: I met Ayan in Perion. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the Stumps that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of Stumps, Ayan can't take a single step out of Perion, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary
